decisions.reason: As a newly launched series that fits the firm's collector-focused physical-media niche, management would likely continue it because the investment is recent, the public commitment has already been made on the site, and any weak early response can still be blamed on the normal test phase.

Because this compilation series is close to the firm's established offer and signals a visible curatorial commitment, management would be inclined to persist with it after only one year, especially in a growing market where disappointing early results can be interpreted as temporary.
